properties.query:
SOURCE "arn:aws:logs:us-west-2:918987959928:log-group:/aws/lambda/production-lambda-applink-metadata-producer" | SOURCE "arn:aws:logs:us-west-2:918987959928:log-group:/aws/lambda/production-lambda-mcr-px-segment-decorator-applink" | fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream, @log

| filter @message like "Total records received from sqs : " 
or strcontains(@message, "One or more participants in interactionId:") 
or strcontains(@message, "One or more recordings in interactionId:") 
or strcontains(@message, "Received contacts with Interaction IDs:") 
or strcontains(@message, "Failed to push segment to SQS. Segment ID:")
or strcontains(@message, "Injecting segments to SQS: SUCCESS COUNT: ")
or strcontains(@message, "Count of records successfully pushed to kinesis: ")

| parse @message "Injecting segments to SQS: SUCCESS COUNT: * " as sent_to_sqs
| parse @message "Total records received from sqs : *" as mcr_recieved_from_sqs
| parse @message "Count of records successfully pushed to kinesis: *" as mcr_success_to_kinesis

| stats
sum(strcontains(@message, "One or more participants in interactionId:")) as participants_validation_error_count,
sum(strcontains(@message, "One or more recordings in interactionId:")) as recording_validation_error_count,
sum(strcontains(@message, "Received contacts with Interaction IDs:")) as received_files_count,
sum(strcontains(@message, "Failed to push segment to SQS. Segment ID:")) as SQS_send_error_count,
sum(sent_to_sqs) as success_id_sent_to_sqs,
sum(mcr_recieved_from_sqs) as decoration_id_recieved_from_sqs,
sum(mcr_success_to_kinesis) as decoration_id_upload_to_kinesis
| sort @timestamp asc
properties.title: Metadata Lambdas statistics

properties.query:
SOURCE "arn:aws:logs:us-west-2:918987959928:log-group:/aws/states/production-applink-audio-state-machine" | fields @message
| filter (details.name = "LogInputSegmentPerTenantId" and type = "PassStateExited") or (@message like "Successfully processed recording." and type = "TaskSucceeded" )
| parse details.output "tenantId\":\"*\"" as TenantId 
| filter ispresent(TenantId)
| parse details.output "@InputSegment@" as Input
| parse details.output "Successfully processed recording." as Output
| parse details.output "tenantName\":\"*\"" as tenantName
| parse details.output "slaTimeInMilliseconds\":*," as slaTime
| stats sortsFirst(tenantName) as TenantName, count(Input) as InputSegments, count(Output) as SuccessSegments, avg(slaTime) / 60000 as Average_SLA_Minutes, concat(round((Average_SLA_Minutes / 60 * 100), 0), "%") as Relative_to_target_SLA_1_hr by TenantId
properties.title: Input / Success
Decoration lambda number of segments submitted to Kinesis

properties.query:
SOURCE "arn:aws:logs:us-west-2:918987959928:log-group:/aws/states/production-applink-audio-state-machine" | SOURCE "arn:aws:logs:us-west-2:918987959928:log-group:/aws/vendedlogs/states/production-applink-screen-state-machine" | stats
sum(strcontains(type, "ExecutionSucceeded") and strcontains(@log,"applink-audio-state-machine")) as audio_success,
sum(strcontains(type, "ExecutionFailed") and strcontains(@log,"applink-audio-state-machine")) as audio_failure,
concat(round((sum(strcontains(type, "ExecutionSucceeded") and strcontains(@log,"applink-audio-state-machine")) * 10000.0) / (sum(strcontains(type, "ExecutionSucceeded") and strcontains(@log,"applink-audio-state-machine")) + sum(strcontains(type, "ExecutionFailed") and strcontains(@log,"applink-audio-state-machine")))) / 100, "%") as audio_success_rate,
sum(strcontains(type, "ExecutionSucceeded") and strcontains(@log,"applink-screen-state-machine")) as screen_success,
sum(strcontains(type, "ExecutionFailed") and strcontains(@log,"applink-screen-state-machine")) as screen_failure,
concat(round((sum(strcontains(type, "ExecutionSucceeded") and strcontains(@log,"applink-screen-state-machine")) * 10000.0) / (sum(strcontains(type, "ExecutionSucceeded") and strcontains(@log,"applink-screen-state-machine")) + sum(strcontains(type, "ExecutionFailed") and strcontains(@log,"applink-screen-state-machine")))) / 100, "%") as screen_success_rate
properties.title: Media State Machine Statistics

properties.query:
SOURCE "arn:aws:logs:us-west-2:918987959928:log-group:/aws/lambda/production-lambda-hybrid-recording-allocated-stats" | fields @message
| filter @message like "updated total_available_rows"
| parse @message "to *. total rows: *" as available, Total_Ranges
| stats min(available) as Available, min(Total_Ranges) - min(available) as Consumed, count() as Consumed_At_Period by Total_Ranges
| display Total_Ranges, Available, Consumed, Consumed_At_Period, concat(round((Available / Total_Ranges) * 100, 2),"%") as Remaining_Ranges_Percent | limit 10
properties.title: Contact Id Ranges Consumption Report (1 Range = 1M Contact IDs)

properties.query:
SOURCE "arn:aws:logs:us-west-2:918987959928:log-group:/aws/lambda/production-lambda-applink-contact-allocator" | fields @message 
| filter @message like "Received event"
| parse @message /\\?"id\\?":\\?"(?<Consumer_Name>[^"\\?]+)\\?"/
| stats sum(strcontains(@message, "Received event")) as Consumption by Consumer_Name
properties.title: Contact Id Ranges Consumption by Product (1 Range = 1M Contact IDs)

properties.query:
SOURCE "arn:aws:logs:us-west-2:918987959928:log-group:/aws/lambda/production-lambda-applink-contact-allocator" | fields @message 
| filter @message like "Received event"
| parse @message /\\?"id\\?":\\?"(?<Product>[^"\\?]+)\\?"/
